sourceQuestions.sourceText: Where is the story set? Write home, school, park or shops. a The children sit at desks and the teacher reads to them. b Gogo buys bananas and looks at shoes in a window. c Timothy looks at the swings and the slide.
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: a school • b shops • c park

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Who bought Shepherd his new red tackies?
What did Timothy really see through his telescope?
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: A cat (its ear looked like a shark fin)
She talked about it / told someone about her Worry.

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Write each verb in the right box. grinned sobbed shook laughed cried whispered (happy / sad / scared)
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: happy: grinned, laughed • sad: sobbed, cried • scared: shook, whispered

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Write this sentence again with capital letters and a full stop. uncle arjun jumped in the boat
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: Uncle Arjun jumped in the boat.

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Add s or es. three dish__ two mug__ four bush__ five bottle__
Plan a story set in the park. Write one line for each part. Beginning: Middle: End:
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: Three lines that follow on: something happens at the start, a problem or adventure in the middle, and a finish at the end — all in a park.

sourceQuestions.sourceText: The setting of a story is ( the name of the story ) ( where the story happens ) ( the last page )
Shepherd's old tackies had ( holes ) ( lights ) ( wheels )
In Mr Gumpy's Outing, the boat ( sailed far away ) ( got stuck in the mud ) ( tipped over )
Katie Morag threw her teddy into the ( sea ) ( bin ) ( garden )
"He sobbed" tells us he felt ( happy ) ( sad ) ( sleepy )
